items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: I was wondering, what was your impression of sort of the rock & roll revolution: Chuck Berry and Elvis and that whole thing. Did it make an impression on you at the time? ... No it didn’t make an impression on me at all.

ctx.x: No, I don’t think. I’ll probably think of some things tonight when I’m in bed, but at the moment no.

Okay. I did think of something just now. I was wondering, what was your impression of sort of the rock & roll revolution: Chuck Berry and Elvis and that whole thing. Did it make an impression on you at the time?
No it didn’t make an impression on me at all. Because I’m just jazz oriented. I liked it, but I only can take so much of it and then I’m going to go back to my comfort zone.
